compress_audio_file: run the encodec CLI to compress a WAV audio file to a compressed .ecdc format
decompress_audio_file: run the encodec CLI to decompress a .ecdc file back to a WAV audio file
compress_and_decompress_roundtrip: run the encodec CLI to compress a WAV file and immediately decompress it to WAV output
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that builds the argparse CLI with bandwidth, HQ, LM, and rescale options
review_check_clipping: review the check_clipping function that detects audio clipping and warns the user to use rescale
